title: Puzzling-Bench: Evaluating Language Models on 23,777 Human-Written Puzzles with Community-Verified Answers
abstract: arXiv:2611.34331v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce Puzzling-Bench, a benchmark of 23,777 puzzles with community-verified answers drawn from the Puzzling Stack Exchange archive (2014-2026): riddles, ciphers, logic grids, lateral-thinking problems, wordplay and recreational mathematics, a third of them with images. Every puzzle carries the answer accepted by its author, a short reference answer taken from it (LLM-extracted for the evaluation sets and checked on a 50-puzzle human review), the author's own hints, community tags and a creation date, so that the benchmark supports hint ablations, category analysis and a rolling post-cutoff slice (254 puzzles posted after the training cutoff of six of the nine models we evaluate, including the best one) as a contamination check. We evaluate nine frontier and open models with a two-tier scorer (normalized exact match, then an LLM judge) and validate the judge with three judges from two model families: they agree on 95-97% of verdi

translated_title: Puzzling-Bench：基于23,777道人工编写、社区验证答案谜题的语言模型评估基准
translated_abstract: 我们推出了Puzzling-Bench，这是一个包含23,777道谜题的基准测试集，谜题选自Puzzling Stack Exchange存档（2014-2026年），均带有社区验证的答案：涵盖谜语、密码、逻辑网格、横向思维问题、文字游戏和趣味数学，其中三分之一配有图片。每道谜题都附有作者认可的答案、从中提取的简短参考答案（评估集的参考答案由LLM提取，并经50道谜题的人工审核验证）、作者本人的提示、社区标签和创建日期，因此该基准支持提示消融实验、类别分析以及滚动更新的训练截止日期后谜题切片（254道谜题发布于我们所评估的九个模型中六个模型的训练截止日期之后，其中包括表现最好的模型），可作为数据污染检查。我们使用两级评分器（先进行归一化精确匹配，再由LLM裁判评分）评估了九个前沿模型和开源模型，并通过来自两个模型系列的三个LLM裁判对裁判进行了验证：它们在95-97%的判定上达成一致……
tldr: Puzzling-Bench是一个基于23,777道来自Puzzling Stack Exchange、带有社区验证答案的人工编写谜题（涵盖谜语、密码、逻辑推理等类别）的语言模型评估基准，并利用训练截止日期后发布的谜题切片来检测数据污染。
en_tdlr: Puzzling-Bench is a benchmark of 23,777 human-written puzzles with community-verified answers from Puzzling Stack Exchange, evaluating language models across riddles, ciphers, and logic puzzles, with a post-cutoff puzzle slice serving as a contamination check.
